title: Left Hand Basics
body: The left hand plays in the bass clef — lower notes that support the melody. The bass clef looks different from the treble clef but works the same way: higher on the staff = higher pitch.

title: The Bass Clef
caption: The curly symbol is the bass clef. Middle C (C4) sits just above the staff here. Practice locating C3, E3, G3 and C4 — these are your anchor points.
